name: Good Trade Gold PRO EA
changelog: Good Trade Gold PRO V7.76 - Prop Firm Daily Guard Persistent Unlock & Baseline Reset Master: Resolved the persistent Max Daily Loss lock bug where clicking the reset/unlock button failed to clear the red MAX LOSS banner due to un-baselined historical deal re-evaluation. Implemented persistent manual unlock memory and baseline PnL snapshotting, allowing instant unlocking of both Auto-Trade and Manual Controller buttons while resetting intraday drawdown tracking from the new baseline, with full GlobalVariables persistence across timeframe switches and MT5 restarts.
